content: Just finished the sprint review for the Lucerne Guest Experience Initiative. Team is behind on the check-in system integration by 3 days.
The delay is due to the legacy hotel management system not exposing the right endpoints. Raised it with IT.
Team morale in Lucerne Operations is quite low this week. Multiple people mentioned feeling overloaded with the new guest-facing services rollout.
Freiburg Panorama Resort renovation is on track. Budget approved by CFO last Friday.
IT confirmed the legacy hotel system fix will take another week. Lucerne Guest Experience Initiative deadline is at serious risk.
